note: CMUI bibliography. Every compute_risk_model.json calculation MUST cite one or more entries here. Shared actuarial / insurance handles remain in contract/citations.json and are cross-referenced by ID.

ST-GPU-DEPRECIATION.title: We need new markets to assess GPU depreciation
ST-GPU-DEPRECIATION.use: Economic life vs accounting depreciation; forward-curve-implied residual value; cloud strata (value trader vs long-tail industrialist); V_0 = Σ m_t·u_t·π_t discount + salvage.

ST-H100-VOLATILITY.title: What's happening to H100 rental prices?
ST-H100-VOLATILITY.use: H100 spot volatility; elasticity premium on on-demand; scarcity repricing vs hardware wear; substitution demand (A100/H100 correlation).

ST-OPEN-WEIGHTS-RISK.title: On open weights and compute market risk
ST-OPEN-WEIGHTS-RISK.use: Open-weight releases externalize demand to fragmented supply; tightness +200% on DeepSeek V4; release-calendar as compute market calendar; short-tenor contract repricing.

ST-H100-PERP.title: H100 hourly perpetual market on Injective / Helix
ST-H100-PERP.use: On-chain GPU-hour price discovery; hedge instrument for index_hedge_coverage; compute as tradable financial primitive.

ST-H100-INDEX.title: Squaretower H100 hourly spot index
ST-H100-INDEX.use: Primary spot feed r_spot, σ_30, σ_90 for price_volatility_exposure and price_basis_gap.

ST-TIGHTNESS-INDEX.title: Squaretower H100 Market Tightness Index
ST-TIGHTNESS-INDEX.use: Capacity scarcity signal; tightness_sensitivity; parametric availability cover trigger substrate.

ST-FORWARD-CURVE.title: Squaretower GPU-hour forward curve

IND-GPU-FORWARD-CURVE.title: The GPU Forward Curve: Pricing the Curve, Not Just the Spot

IND-SILICON-H100.title: SDH100RT — H100 rental spot index
